name: Club Brugge KV

ucl_2026_27.qualified_via: Belgian Pro League 2025/26 champions (20th title, won via the Champions' Play-offs)

head_coach.name: Ivan Leko
head_coach.preferred_formation: 3-5-2 in his first spell (2017-19); 2026/27 shape not verified
style_keywords: pragmatic and demanding in public ('my teams are never sympathetic')
forces intensity and work-rate over aesthetics
second spell after winning the title and Super Cup in 2017-18

identity.playing_style: Leko's first Club Brugge side (2017-19) was known for a dominant, attacking 3-5-2 built around Vanaken; in his second spell (from Dec 2025) he inherited Hayen's title-chasing squad and delivered the 20th championship via the play-offs, but has publicly criticised his team for wanting to 'do it too nicely' and demanded harder work (Sporza, Aug 2026). The 2025/26 attack ran through Tzolis (22 goals, 29 assists in 52 games) and Tresoldi (23 goals); with Tzolis, Stankovic and Onyedika sold, the 2026/27 team is being re-shaped around Vanaken, Potts, Tresoldi and young wide players.
principles: buy-to-sell talent model with record exits (Tzolis EUR 40m to Arsenal - JPL record; Stankovic, Onyedika: the three sales brought in EUR 70m+)
reinvest in young, undervalued profiles from Switzerland, Scandinavia and England (Vasovic, Tsawa, Lee, Potts, Angulo)
majority-owner-driven long-term project incl. a new 40,116-seat stadium (Olympia site, target 2028-29)
Club NXT reserve team as a pathway (Angulo placed there)
annual UCL participation as a financial pillar (5th league-phase campaign in a row)
identity.club_character: Belgium's dominant club of the last decade (titles 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2026) with a passionate, demanding fanbase at the ageing Jan Breydel Stadium and a strong regional identity in West Flanders. Media pressure is moderate compared with the big-five leagues, but expectations are the title every season plus UCL knockout football; the 2025/26 3-3 home draw with Atletico showed the atmosphere the ground can generate.
identity.ownership: Private: chairman Bart Verhaeghe controls about 73% via the holding NV Grizzly Sports (board incl. Vincent Mannaert, Jan Boone of Lotus Bakeries and Peter Vanhecke of Castel Capital); Jan Boone is also a minority shareholder. The club restructured its ownership 'with a view to future growth' (club statement).
identity.political_and_social_context: Publicly documented: the new stadium project at the Olympia site survived a residents' appeal at the Council for Permit Disputes, clearing construction of a 40,116-capacity ground; the club has been reported as open to new investors ('Te koop: Club Brugge', Voetbalbelgie). No institution-level controversies beyond the stadium dispute found in this research.
identity.wage_structure: unknown (reported salaries: Forbs ~EUR 1.3m gross/yr, Seys ~EUR 0.43m - TransferFeed, unverified)
identity.transfer_policy: Sell one or two stars per summer to the Premier League/Serie A/Bundesliga at EUR 20-40m and replace with 18-23-year-olds from smaller European leagues at EUR 3-12m; free-agent experience where cheap (Sommer). Potts (~EUR 12m incl. bonuses) is the window's record buy.

last_season_2025_26.ucl_result: Knockout play-off (lost 4-7 on aggregate to Atletico Madrid: 3-3 home, 1-4 away, Feb 2026)
last_season_2025_26.domestic_cup: Eliminated before the final (round not verified); final won 3-1 by Union SG over Anderlecht

squad.name: Kevin Angulo
squad.injury_flag: signed from America de Cali; initially placed with Club NXT (reserves)

strengths: Serial domestic winners (20th title in 2026) with five consecutive UCL league-phase campaigns and a 2025/26 knockout appearance.
Proven scorer retained: Tresoldi (19 league / 23 total goals in 2025/26, contract to 2029) despite Barcelona/Premier League interest.
Strong selling record funds continual reinvestment: Tzolis EUR 40m (JPL record), Stankovic and Onyedika together EUR 70m+.
Experienced spine in Vanaken, Mechele and new GK Sommer around young full-backs Seys and Sabbe.
Stable, well-capitalised private ownership with a new stadium approved.
weaknesses: Creative output gutted: Tzolis contributed 22 goals and 29 assists in 2025/26 and has not been directly replaced.
Both first-choice holding midfielders (Onyedika, Stankovic) sold in one window; Potts and 19-year-old Tsawa step in.
Centre-back turnover (Ordonez and Romero out, Lee in) ahead of ties with Liverpool, Inter and Napoli.
Regular-season defence was porous for a champion (36 conceded in 30 games) and the side conceded 7 in two legs to Atletico.
Coach's tactical model for 2026/27 not yet settled; Leko publicly critical of the squad's mentality in Aug 2026.

positional_needs.reason: Tzolis sold to Arsenal; Diakhon and Forbs are the only senior wide options.
Onyedika and Stankovic both departed; Potts is new to the league.
Ordonez (reported to Palace) and Romero left; Mechele is the veteran.
